name: share-to-spacesheep
description: Share webpages and files to spacesheep.dev from Android, iPhone/iPad (Share Extension), and macOS

scripts.build:ios-sim: xcodebuild -project ios/ShareToSpacesheep.xcodeproj -scheme ShareToSpacesheep -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator build SYMROOT="$PWD/ios/build"
scripts.build:ipa: xcodebuild -project ios/ShareToSpacesheep.xcodeproj -scheme ShareToSpacesheep -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" SYMROOT="$PWD/ios/build" && rm -rf /tmp/ipa_stage && mkdir -p /tmp/ipa_stage/Payload && cp -R ios/build/Release-iphoneos/ShareToSpacesheep.app /tmp/ipa_stage/Payload/ && (cd /tmp/ipa_stage && zip -qry /tmp/share-to-spacesheep-v0.1.0.ipa Payload)
